chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام looked at the people on a day of Fiṭr while they were playing and laughing, so he said to his companions and turned toward them.

"Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created the month of Ramaḍān as a racecourse for His creation, in which they compete through obedience to Him toward His good pleasure. So some people went ahead in it and thus succeeded, while others fell behind and thus failed. How astonishing—truly all astonishing—is the laughing, playing person on the day in which the doers of good are rewarded and the negligent fail. By Allah, were the covering to be lifted, a doer of good would be occupied with his goodness, and an evildoer with his evil."

key_terms.بِإِحْسَانِهِ: with his good conduct and righteous deeds
key_terms.شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ: the month designated for spiritual striving and obedience
key_terms.مِضْمَارًا: a racecourse or training ground for competition
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْسِنُونَ: those who do good and excel in righteous action
key_terms.ٱلْمُقَصِّرُونَ: those who fell short and were negligent

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hasan عليه السلام say about laughing and اللعب on Eid al-Fiṭr after Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This narration presents the month of Ramaḍān as a spiritual race in which people strive through obedience to attain Allah’s pleasure. Eid al-Fiṭr is portrayed not merely as a day of amusement, but as a moment of consequence when the virtuous are rewarded and the negligent suffer loss, calling the believer to reflection and seriousness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2057 - Imam Al-Hasan ibn Ali (as) observed the people on the Day of Eid al-Fitr playing and laughing. Imam (as) turned to his companions and said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, created the Month of Ramadan as a racecourse for His creation, where they compete in obedience to Him to attain His pleasure. Some have advanced in it and succeeded, while others have lagged behind and failed. Astonishing, truly astonishing, is the laughter and play of one on a day when the righteous are rewarded, and the negligent face disappointment. By Allah (swt), if the veil were lifted, the doer of good would be preoccupied with his goodness, and the sinner with his sins."
